visualCharacteristics.purpose: Großes Bild neben Textspalte mit Überschrift, Text, Liste und Button
visualCharacteristics.layout: 50/50 split on desktop, stacked on mobile (image first)

contentPattern.structure: image (with alt) | heading, paragraph, bullet list, button link. Authored as one row with two cells (image | text) or, in Universal Editor, as an image field plus a text group (title, rich text body, link)

reuseGuidance: Use for a single fixed image/text pair side by side; for repeating items use a cards variant.
